title: To Solitude
text: THOU world, tumultuous and rude, Farewell; and welcome solitude! Here straight the path to Heaven lies; Farewell, thou world of vanities! Let nations and let princes rage, Here lofty themes my thoughts engage; The skies with hymns angelic ring; With angels let me learn to sing! Oh, here for ever may I dwell, Far from the world's tumultuous swell, Till Angels lift me to the skies, And bear my soul to Paradise. Oh, let me here, a hermit blest, Enjoy a life of precious rest!
